text: Big ideas parking lot: things too large for now, worth a research round each
description: Collected while exploring (2026-11-24): differentiable rendering of the splat loop end to end on GPU (train in the app itself, on the scene); self-play training without video (the net hallucinates, a critic rates); a human rating loop in the headset (look at a patch, a button says 'more of this'); evolutionary search over random-weight nets (wild fader) keeping the ones people like; distillation from a big world model into the 5k net; audio-reactive rules; multiplayer where each player's state seeds the other's.
